$$
\begin{aligned}x & =2 (-2)+1=-4+1=-3 \\ y & =2 (-2)^{3}+3 (-2)=-16-6=-22\end{aligned}
$$

So we're looking to find the equation of the tangent line to the curve at the point $(-3,-22).$

To find the slope of the tangent line, we need to find $\dfrac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}.$ To compute it, we first need to find the derivatives of $x$ and $y,$ as follows:

$$
x'(t)=2,\qquad y'(t)=6 t^{2}+3.
$$

So, we have

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}=\frac{y'(t)}{x'(t)}=\frac{6 t^{2}+3}{2}.
$$

At the point where $t=-2,$ the slope of the tangent line is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}m & =\frac{6 (-2)^{2}+3}{2}=\frac{27}{2}=\frac{27}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, to calculate the equation of the tangent line, we use point-slope form with the point $(x_1,y_1)=(-3,-22)$ and the slope $m=\frac{27}{2}.$ We get

$$

$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["f7ce7cf3-8ac9-5f5b-8f37-c3976de623e6"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "b5310c74-6e0b-51a9-aff4-4d53c2d25c98" :answer/id #uuid "b5310c74-6e0b-51a9-aff4-4d53c2d25c98" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "y+3=-\frac{1}{4}(x-3)" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "cb045f3e-c0a3-548a-bc9e-f97458d3c0cb" :answer/id #uuid "cb045f3e-c0a3-548a-bc9e-f97458d3c0cb" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "y-3=-\frac{1}{4}(x+3)" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "b67dcb0a-7a53-5b01-b1e6-05915ba430aa" :answer/id #uuid "b67dcb0a-7a53-5b01-b1e6-05915ba430aa" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "y-3=-4(x-3)" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "5072b8c8-db19-54cc-aab6-49d577cbbf16" :answer/id #uuid "5072b8c8-db19-54cc-aab6-49d577cbbf16" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "y-3=-\frac{1}{4}(x-3)" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "2ece599e-7211-53e4-b852-c09c4aef59f8" :answer/id #uuid "2ece599e-7211-53e4-b852-c09c4aef59f8" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "y-3=\frac{1}{4}(x-3)" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "584a63db-59f3-5c89-94e7-c2d1bdc0d843" :answer-field/id #uuid "584a63db-59f3-5c89-94e7-c2d1bdc0d843" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["b5310c74-6e0b-51a9-aff4-4d53c2d25c98" "cb045f3e-c0a3-548a-bc9e-f97458d3c0cb" "b67dcb0a-7a53-5b01-b1e6-05915ba430aa" "5072b8c8-db19-54cc-aab6-49d577cbbf16" "2ece599e-7211-53e4-b852-c09c4aef59f8"] :answer-field/correct "5072b8c8-db19-54cc-aab6-49d577cbbf16" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "a69cf94a-f746-5a19-9f67-7603835405a5" :question/id #uuid "a69cf94a-f746-5a19-9f67-7603835405a5" :question/problem "A curve is defined by the parametric equations
